meta.source: none: first system, no UI in the repository yet. Mirrored in the repository at design/tokens.json.

tokens.name: mask-900
tokens.usage: Page background. Bench: a solder-mask green so dark it reads as near-black. Board: a pale green-grey. Every other surface sits on it.

tokens.name: mask-800
tokens.usage: Panels: the device card, partition table, log console, dialogs. Separate panels from mask-900 with a mask-600 hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: mask-600
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between table rows and panels. Decorative only: never the sole border of an input or button.

tokens.name: trace
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and checkboxes: 3.4:1 on mask-800 in Bench, 3.8:1 in Board (meets the 3:1 control-border rule).

tokens.name: silk
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, like silkscreen on a board. 15:1 on mask-900 in Bench, 14:1 in Board.

tokens.name: silk-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units, column headers, timestamps in the log. At least 5.8:1 on mask-900 and mask-800 in both themes.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action (Flash, Read, Connect), focus ring, selected partition, progress fill. Text on copper uses on-copper. As text: 6.3:1 in Bench, 5:1 on mask-800 in Board.

tokens.name: on-copper
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a copper fill: 6.3:1 in Bench, 5:1 in Board.

tokens.name: signal-ok
tokens.usage: Device connected in EDL (9008), write verified, sector range OK. Always paired with a label or icon. Board: 5.6:1 on mask-800.

tokens.name: signal-warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention: unsigned loader, protected partition, Sahara version mismatch. Lightest of the three signals in both themes. Board: 4.5:1 on mask-800 but only 4.0:1 on mask-900, so set warning text on a panel, or at 18px and up on the page.

tokens.name: signal-fault
tokens.usage: Failure: NAK from Firehose, USB disconnect mid-write, hash mismatch. Darkest of the three signals in both themes; pair with an icon and the device's error text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the device or job state. Chakra Petch, used sparingly.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select a Firehose loader that matches the device's hardware ID.
styles.usage: Running text, dialog copy, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field and column labels. Set in uppercase in CSS, written in sentence case in source.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Addresses, sector ranges, hashes, serials, partition names. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: The log console. One line per protocol event, prefixed by its layer: sahara, firehose, usb, diag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap between related controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs. The largest radius in the system; nothing is pill-shaped.
